description: Maya has the only key to her late grandfather's garage, where his upright piano has been stored, and must make the final call about the piano's destination, preparation, transport, and handoff after the family decides what to do with it.

agents.name: Maya
agents.role: Garage Key Holder and Final Decision-Maker

shared_context.S1: Their late grandfather's upright piano is in the locked family garage, and Maya has the only key.
shared_context.S2: The piano is too heavy for one person, and the garage door opens onto a narrow driveway.
shared_context.S3: The family wants the piano handled respectfully rather than left to deteriorate or discarded casually.
shared_context.S4: Maya is making the final plan for the piano's destination, preparation, transport, and handoff.
shared_context.S5: At the family meeting, Maya's usual practice is to ask each person in turn for anything that should shape the plan before she settles it.

PF1.text: Eli spoke with the director of the Oak Street youth music room, who said they will accept this piano for their lesson room if it arrives with a bench and a basic tuning; this has not reached the whole family yet.

PF2.text: After looking at the piano's condition, Samira recommends securing the keyboard lid and using four-wheel piano skates with two moving straps; ordinary furniture sliders would risk the instrument on the narrow driveway.

PF3.text: Jonah already promised to provide a covered van and help with the move on 2026-09-19 from 09:00 to 11:00, but the promise has not yet been brought to Maya.

PF4.text: Ruth found their grandfather's handwritten note saying the piano should go to the Oak Street youth music room rather than be sold, and she has not shown the note to the group yet.

acceptance_conditions: The piano must go to the Oak Street youth music room.
The handoff must include the piano bench.
The piano must receive a basic tuning before or as part of the handoff.
The keyboard lid must be secured and the move must use four-wheel piano skates with two moving straps.
The move must occur on 2026-09-19 from 09:00 through 11:00.
A commitment must confirm the covered-van move and handoff.

decisive_facts.why: The Oak Street director's acceptance supplies the exact destination, requires the bench and basic tuning, and makes a confirmed handoff workable instead of leaving the piano's recipient and preparation unspecified.
Samira's assessment changes the preparation from ordinary furniture moving to securing the keyboard lid and using four-wheel piano skates with two moving straps.
Jonah's existing promise fixes the move date at 2026-09-19, the window at 09:00-11:00, and the transport commitment as a covered-van move and handoff.
Grandfather's note changes the disposition from an arbitrary sale, storage choice, or donation to the exact Oak Street youth music room and supplies the private fact Maya must cite.
